newsitem.title: UK: Signet signs 3-yr $360 mln credit facility.
newsitem.headline: Signet signs 3-yr $360 mln credit facility.

text.p: Britain's Signet Group said on Thursday it entered into a new three-year voluntary $360 million multi-currency credit facility with a syndicate of four banks.
The syndicate would be led by BZW, Midland Bank Plc, Banque Paribas and the Royal Bank of Scotland.
Signet said this was a new syndicate and the banks who were party to the group's existing two-year facility, due to expire in June 1997, would be repaid in full.
Signet said it was advised by Deutsche Morgan Grenfell .
The jewellery and watches manufacturer also said it might restructure its share capital by converting its outstanding preference shares into new ordinary shares.
